# nxstudio

> nxstudio is a founder-mode build tool that turns a product brief into a
> derived tech stack and one production-ready build prompt for AI coding agents.
> Hosted at https://nxstudio.dev

nxstudio compresses the messy pre-build phase — "I have an idea, what do I
actually build and how do I tell an AI to build it?" — into a short, guided
workflow. A founder fills in a Brief (problem, audience, current solutions,
differentiation), nxstudio derives an opinionated tech stack, and then compiles
a single, structured build prompt you can hand to Claude Code, Cursor, or any
AI coding agent to scaffold the product.

## What it does

- **Brief → Tech Stack**: Capture idea, audience, and brand, then derive a
  platform, framework, and architecture recommendation.
- **One build prompt**: Compile everything into a single production-ready prompt
  optimized for AI coding agents — no prompt-engineering expertise required.
- **Phase tracking**: Move a product from idea to shipped through Brief, Tech
  Stack, and Build phases, with custom stages for your own workflow.

## Who it is for

Founders, indie hackers, and product builders who use AI coding agents
(Claude Code, Cursor, and similar) and want to go from a rough idea to a
concrete, buildable spec and prompt without hand-writing the plan.

## Key concepts

- **Build prompt**: A structured, context-rich prompt that tells an AI coding
  agent exactly what to build, on what stack, with what constraints.
- **Derived tech stack**: An opinionated stack recommendation generated from the
  brief rather than chosen blindly.
- **Founder mode**: Optimized for one person shipping fast, not for large teams.

## Pricing

- Free: $0 forever — 1 product workspace with full access to everything
  (visual canvas, brief, derived tech stack, and the full build prompt).
- Pro: 10 USDT per 28-day cycle — unlimited product workspaces, project
  collections, the prompt gallery, and agent-specific targets
  (.cursor/rules, .claude, etc.). Card, UPI, and netbanking via Razorpay, or
  USDC/USDT on Solana, verified on-chain.
